about: Which notes sound while a held playhead moves from 'from' to 'to' (#582 items 12 and 13): one case per rule, the same for the score and the roll. tests/shared/scrub-rule.test.mjs runs it on scrubStrikes (Scripts/playback/playback-processor.ts) and PlaybackTests.swift on PlaybackEngine.scrubStrikes. 'onsets' are the starts of the audible notes (music-core's, a tie merged into its first note), ticks at 480 a quarter; 'opening' is a gesture's first move; at most 6 starts a move. Each strike is a start and how far through the move the playhead reaches it, 0 to 1, in the order it does.

cases.name: forward: the starts in (from, to]; the place it leaves is behind it
forward, a gesture's first move: the note under the playhead as it leaves sounds too
back: the starts in [to, from), the place reached sounds
back, a gesture's first move: the place it leaves too
a fast move forward: only the starts nearest where it went, in the order it passed them
a fast move back: the nearest where it went, in the order it passed them
a gesture's first move that stands still: the note where it stands
a later move that stands still sounds nothing
over the note a tie goes on to: nothing, the tie is one note from its first
onto a tie's first note: the tie sounds
thirty-seconds between sixteenths: each start at its own place in the move
a triplet's starts off the sixteenth grid
